scope: LSP and CodeGraph launchers, CodeGraph initialization test, MCP bootstrap, and project extension discovery and skill catalog

lspLogSteering.observation: With independent workspace and log cclsp.json files, startup selected the log directory's configuration.

lspStaleDiagnostics.observation: The same open document still reported its original type error after an ordinary disk edit cleared it.

codegraphAlias.observation: A real codegraph_explore without projectPath returned the session index under the alias-only configuration.

bootstrap.observation: The installer published the deprecated sg wrapper instead of the installed ast-grep engine.

extension.observation: A missing manifest suppressed a good user skill and a newly created project extension did not advance the cached catalog's revision.

lsp.observation: One MCP session observed a TypeScript error, clean file, and a different TypeScript error. A deterministic push peer checks the stale cache transition and the unchanged twelve-tool MCP list.

codegraph.observation: Actual default MCP queries used the alias index, and the canonical override still won. The cwd fallback test completed without invoking real indexing.

extension.observation: The real pinned Harness SkillRegistry observed cached user skill, added same-id project skill, then the restored user skill after manifest corruption in one live registry.

bootstrap.observation: Fresh npm install completed. An npm-success fixture with a broken platform engine emitted no pin and wrote no activation file.

derivedDist.observation: All scoped canonical outputs were fresh after the integration seat rebuilt them. The SHA-pinned adopted CodeGraph prebuilt compared unchanged against HEAD.

bounds: Behavior was exercised on Linux. Windows/macOS and non-TypeScript production language servers were not exercised.

LSP adaptation is specific to the verified cclsp 0.7.0 source shape. Other releases or altered layouts launch without the adaptation. Versionless late diagnostic notifications cannot be matched to a document version.
Extension catalog refresh depends on filesystem watch events and the registration control supported by the host. The router was exercised directly with the real SkillRegistry without a model turn.
Writer evidence is separate from the independent release verdict. No Git writes were made by this lane.
